# Authoritative list of CircleCI status-check contexts that MUST be required by
# a repository ruleset protecting main. One context per line; blank lines and
# # comments are ignored.
#
# TODAY THIS REPOSITORY HAS NO SUCH RULESET. `gh api /repos/arangodb/servicemaker
# /rulesets` returns only the two enterprise-sourced rules
# (stable-branch-no-force-push, stable-branch-no-delete) and main has no branch
# protection, so every gate below blocks pipeline progression and NONE of them
# blocks a merge. Creating the ruleset is an owner action; the
# required-checks-drift job reports the gap on every run and flips to blocking in
# the same change that creates the ruleset.
#
# WHY THESE STRINGS ARE STABLE. CircleCI appends an instance suffix when the same
# job name appears more than once in a pipeline, and the scheme is not
# predictable. Every scan instance in .circleci/config.yml therefore carries an
# explicit `name:` (bare in the default workflow, -nightly / -rebuild elsewhere),
# so no future topology change can renumber them. Verify after any topology
# change with either of:
#   circleci config process --org-slug gh/arangodb .circleci/config.yml
#   gh pr checks <PR>
# The first reproduces CircleCI's instance naming, the second is authoritative.

# Compiles, clippy, and the integration test that renders and helm-lints a
# generated service chart
ci/circleci: build-and-test

# Dependency CVEs, fixable CRITICAL/HIGH, waivers subtracted at gate time
ci/circleci: dependency-cve-scan

# Dockerfile and template misconfiguration, plus the final-stage
# build-credential guard
ci/circleci: misconfig-scan

# SAST tier 1: full repo, ERROR band
ci/circleci: sast-scan

# SAST tier 2: newly introduced findings, WARNING band (the only tier that
# gates Rust, since p/rust ships no ERROR rules)
ci/circleci: sast-scan-diff

# Waiver and disposition integrity: undated, expired, over-window or
# unattributed accepted risks, and any shrinkage of SAST scope
ci/circleci: disposition-check

# The published base images and the two reference service images: fixable
# CRITICAL/HIGH in the image, plus the image-config secret scan and the EOL
# base-OS check
ci/circleci: py12base
ci/circleci: py12cugraph
ci/circleci: py12torch
ci/circleci: node22base
ci/circleci: test-service
ci/circleci: test-service-nodejs

# NOT REQUIRED YET, deliberately:
#   ci/circleci: secret-scan
#     Report-only for one enumeration cycle with .circleci/trivy-secret.yaml in
#     place, so genuine fixtures get dated allow-rules before the gate can go
#     red. Add this line in the same change that sets fail-on-findings: true.
#   ci/circleci: required-checks-drift
#     Warn-only by construction; requiring a check that can never fail adds no
#     protection.
